# VSS pipeline parameter reference

This table is grounded in the VSS sample app code under `sample-applications/video-search-and-summarization`.

| Parameter | User-facing name | API/DTO field | Where set | Default | Range / validation in code | Effect on quality | Effect on latency / cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chunk duration | `chunk Duration (secs)` (`ChunkDurationLabel`) | `SummaryPipelineDTO.sampling.chunkDuration`; EVAM request `parameters.chunk_duration`; DataPrep DTO has optional `chunk_duration` for video embeddings | UI: `ui/react/src/components/VideoActions/VideoSummarizeFlow.tsx` `NumberInput id='chunkDuration'`; legacy `ui/react/src/components/Drawer/VideoUpload.tsx`; API DTO in `pipeline-manager/src/summary/models/summary-pipeline.model.ts`; consumed by EVAM in `pipeline-manager/src/evam/services/evam.service.ts` and by transcript/time mapping in `pipeline-manager/src/state-manager/queues/chunking.service.ts` | UI state default `8`; API requires it; CLI examples may use their own YAML defaults/examples | UI min `2`; no backend max found | Shorter chunks improve temporal precision and local captions; longer chunks can preserve broader scene context but may blur brief events | Shorter chunks produce more chunks, metadata, queue items, and summary inputs; longer chunks reduce orchestration overhead |
| Frames per chunk / frame sampling | `Frame per chunk` (`FramePerChunkLabel`); status text says `Sample Rate: {{frames}} frames every {{interval}} seconds` | `SummaryPipelineDTO.sampling.samplingFrame`; EVAM request `parameters.frame` | UI: `VideoSummarizeFlow.tsx` `NumberInput id='sampleFrame'`; legacy drawer; API DTO; consumed by `EvamService.startChunkingStub()` and `ChunkingService.prepareFrames()` / transcript alignment | UI state default `8`; API requires it | UI min `2`; backend requires `samplingFrame + frameOverlap == multiFrame`; derived value must not exceed max batch size | More frames improve visual coverage and short-action capture | More frames increase ingestion output, image payloads to VLM, VLM calls/work, and memory/network pressure |
| Frame overlap | `Frames Overlap` | `SummaryPipelineDTO.sampling.frameOverlap`; server `SystemConfig.frameOverlap` | UI Advanced/Ingestion Settings: `NumberInput id='overrideMultiFrame'` in legacy drawer and `VideoSummarizeFlow.tsx`; API DTO; merged in `SummaryController.startSummaryPipeline()`; consumed by `ChunkingService.prepareFrames()` | UI/server default `0`; config has `openai.vlmCaptioning.frameOverlap: 0` | UI min `0`, max `systemConfig.multiFrame`; effective max is `systemConfig.multiFrame - samplingFrame` because backend validates `frameOverlap + samplingFrame == multiFrame` and max batch size | Reduces missed events at frame-group boundaries | Duplicates frames across captioning windows, increasing VLM calls/payloads when overlap is positive |
| Multi-frame factor / batch size | `Batch size` (`MultiFrame`) / `Multi Frames` status | `SummaryPipelineDTO.sampling.multiFrame`; server `SystemConfig.multiFrame`; env-backed config `openai.vlmCaptioning.multiFrame` | UI read-only value computed as `sampleFrame + frameOverlap` (`TextInput id='overrideOverlap'` in `VideoSummarizeFlow.tsx`; legacy drawer computes/mins it); API must send it; max configured by `MULTI_FRAME_COUNT` in `pipeline-manager/src/config/configuration.ts`, compose variable `PM_MULTI_FRAME_COUNT`, or Helm `pipelinemanager.env.MULTI_FRAME_COUNT` | Pipeline manager config default `MULTI_FRAME_COUNT ?? 12`; `setup.sh` defaults `PM_MULTI_FRAME_COUNT=12`; `chart/values.yaml` defaults `12`; some OVMS accelerator paths set `6` | Backend rejects `multiFrame > systemConfig.multiFrame`; backend rejects if `multiFrame != frameOverlap + samplingFrame`; UI warns when `frameOverlap + sampleFrame > systemConfig.multiFrame` | Larger image groups provide more temporal context per VLM caption | Larger multimodal requests cost more per call and may exceed backend/model limits; smaller batches reduce per-call load but may create less contextual captions |
| Audio transcription enablement | `Use Audio Transcription`; `Audio Models` | Presence of `SummaryPipelineDTO.audio.audioModel`; internal `SystemConfig.audioModel`; transcription request `AudioTranscriptDTO.model_name` | UI Audio Settings checkbox `id='audiocheckBox'` and select `id='audioModelsSelector'`; default model from `GET /app/config` `systemConfig.meta.defaultAudioModel`; API `audio` object; `PipelineService` triggers audio when `state.systemConfig.audioModel` is set; `AudioQueueService` posts transcription request | UI `audio` state starts `true`; selected model defaults to audio service `default_model` when available; if no audio host/models, audio settings are absent | Toggle boolean in UI; `audioModel` should be one of `systemConfig.meta.audioModels[].model_id` returned from audio service | Improves summaries for speech, narration, dialogue, and visually ambiguous events; chunk prompts receive matching transcript snippets | Adds Whisper/audio analyzer job latency; transcript parsing and prompt injection add data volume |
| Full audio transcript summary | `Summarize audio transcript for final summary` | `SummaryPipelineDTO.audio.useFullTranscriptSummary`; internal `SystemConfig.audioUseFullTranscriptSummary`; env `AUDIO_USE_FULL_TRANSCRIPT_SUMMARY` | UI checkbox `id='useAudioSummaryCheckbox'`; API `audio.useFullTranscriptSummary`; default from `pipeline-manager/src/config/configuration.ts` `audio.useFullTranscriptSummary`; compose/setup variable `PM_AUDIO_USE_FULL_TRANSCRIPT_SUMMARY`; Helm `pipelinemanager.env.AUDIO_USE_FULL_TRANSCRIPT_SUMMARY`; consumed by `AudioQueueService` and `SummaryQueueService` | Env default `AUDIO_USE_FULL_TRANSCRIPT_SUMMARY ?? 'true'`; setup docs default `PM_AUDIO_USE_FULL_TRANSCRIPT_SUMMARY=true`; UI initializes from `GET /app/config` | Boolean; UI disables/sends false when `produceFinalSummary` is false | Improves final summaries for dialogue-heavy videos by injecting a condensed transcript summary into `%audio_summary%` | Adds a separate LLM map-reduce task over the transcript before final video summary; final summary waits for audio summary |
| Final video summary | `Produce final video summary` | `SummaryPipelineDTO.produceFinalSummary`; internal `SystemConfig.produceFinalSummary`; env `PRODUCE_FINAL_SUMMARY` | UI checkbox `id='produceFinalSummaryCheckbox'`; API top-level `produceFinalSummary`; default from `pipeline-manager/src/config/configuration.ts` `summary.produceFinalSummary`; compose `PM_PRODUCE_FINAL_SUMMARY`; Helm `pipelinemanager.env.PRODUCE_FINAL_SUMMARY`; consumed by `SummaryQueueService.streamTrigger()` and audio summary gating | Env default `PRODUCE_FINAL_SUMMARY ?? 'true'`; UI default `true` then reset from server config | Boolean | On keeps a cohesive final video-level map-reduce summary; off leaves only chunk summaries | On costs LLM final summary work; off is faster and skips full audio transcript summary |

## Source-file details

- `pipeline-manager/src/summary/models/summary-pipeline.model.ts`: defines `SummaryPipelineSampling` (`chunkDuration`, `samplingFrame`, `frameOverlap`, `multiFrame`), `SummaryPipelineAudio` (`audioModel`, `useFullTranscriptSummary`), and `SummaryPipelineDTO`.
- `pipeline-manager/src/summary/controllers/summary.controller.ts`: validates `multiFrame`; requires `multiFrame == frameOverlap + samplingFrame`; rejects values above `systemConfig.multiFrame`; applies `audio.audioModel`, `audio.useFullTranscriptSummary`, and `produceFinalSummary`.
- `pipeline-manager/src/config/configuration.ts`: defines env-backed defaults: `MULTI_FRAME_COUNT ?? 12`, `frameOverlap: 0`, `AUDIO_USE_FULL_TRANSCRIPT_SUMMARY ?? 'true'`, `PRODUCE_FINAL_SUMMARY ?? 'true'`, `VLM_CONCURRENT`, `LLM_CONCURRENT`, token limits, and service endpoints.
- `pipeline-manager/src/video-upload/services/app-config.service.ts`: builds `SystemConfig` for UI defaults and parses env booleans.
- `pipeline-manager/src/evam/services/evam.service.ts`: maps `samplingFrame` to EVAM `parameters.frame` and `chunkDuration` to `parameters.chunk_duration`.
- `pipeline-manager/src/state-manager/queues/chunking.service.ts`: uses `multiFrame`, `frameOverlap`, and `samplingFrame` to form VLM frame groups; injects time-matched audio transcript snippets.
- `pipeline-manager/src/state-manager/queues/audio-queue.service.ts`: starts transcription only when `audioModel` exists; triggers full transcript summary only when `audioUseFullTranscriptSummary` and final summary are enabled.
- `pipeline-manager/src/state-manager/queues/summary-queue.service.ts`: skips final summary when `produceFinalSummary === false`; waits for transcript summary when enabled.
- `ui/react/src/components/VideoActions/VideoSummarizeFlow.tsx`: current upload flow defaults (`chunkDuration=8`, `sampleFrame=8`, `frameOverlap=0`, `audio=true`, `produceFinalSummary=true`) and builds the API DTO.
- `ui/react/src/components/Drawer/VideoUpload.tsx`: legacy drawer with the same core fields/defaults.
- `ui/react/src/utils/i18n/translations/en.ts`: user-facing labels such as `chunk Duration (secs)`, `Frame per chunk`, `Frames Overlap`, `Batch size`, `Use Audio Transcription`, and `Summarize audio transcript for final summary`.
- `docker/compose.base.yaml`, `docker/compose.summary.yaml`, `setup.sh`, and `chart/values.yaml`: deployment-level env wiring/defaults for pipeline-manager settings.
